cases.name: real_nested_and_recursive_entry
cases.setup: Construct original SwiftReactorInstance; enter two different real decoded functions and the same function recursively via private phase, with real caller parameter/operand values.
cases.required: Frame, cache PinRecord, cache usage, ActivePins and live Frames increase once per entered frame; parameters are not appended twice; actual locals and function controls match decoded source.

cases.name: normal_nested_and_outer_return
cases.setup: Return zero-result and single-result real frames through finish.
cases.required: Callee locals/parameters/controls and one actual pin retire; caller gets exactly one value via existing push; only outermost copied result escapes; exact work/pop/release/push order.

cases.name: call_depth_and_pin_ceilings
cases.setup: Narrow frames and active_pins independently; use bounded recursion until each limit.
cases.required: Failure occurs before prohibited publication/acquisition; all prior actual frame pins survive then drain; no allocation or new frame after ceiling.

cases.name: parameters_locals_255_256_257
cases.setup: Decode real functions near 256 combined parameters/locals; include values of all four scalar types.
cases.required: 256 succeeds under legal signature count; 257 fails before local publication; zero-value bits exact; 128 parameter ceiling remains sealed.

cases.name: function_control_and_aggregate_controls
cases.setup: Fill real caller blocks in future shared control route to per-function 512 including Function and aggregate 4096, with narrowed variants.
cases.required: Function control consumes its slot; no 513th per-function or 4097th aggregate publication; no frozen Limits widening.

cases.name: every_entry_work_prefix
cases.setup: For fixed small real functions enumerate all execution_work ceilings from 0 through successful entry work total and local check boundaries.
cases.required: Original 1 then locals+1 charges preserved; completed work never refunded; prior caller arena unchanged on rejection; first cause uses actual WASI.

cases.name: predebit_and_capacity_faults
cases.setup: Force each exact Values/Controls/Frames predebit and fixed room check to reject using narrower budgets and isolated private hooks.
cases.required: No matching publication on failed debit; successful earlier local/control effects removed; guard tracks only acquired counts; zero allocator requests in warm phase.

cases.name: local_initialization_cancellation
cases.setup: Cancel at every before-local initialization check after a bounded number of successful real local pushes.
cases.required: No locals view crosses mutation; only actual appended locals removed; all caller params/control untouched; acquired pin returned or retained explicitly.

cases.name: pin_and_phase_completion_failure
cases.setup: Acquire actual cache pin then inject original construction completion rejection before refund; also pin failure plus completion rejection.
cases.required: PinAttempt contains pin and failure simultaneously; empty return slots consumed; nested exact bound recorded; first failure unchanged; no frame published.

cases.name: entry_guard_release_rejection
cases.setup: After real acquired pin and partial entry effects force same-owner cache release pre-effect rejection.
cases.required: Actual guard pin stays in State.entry with unresolved charges; no token drop; guard attempted at most once in pass; consuming cleanup rejects intact.

cases.name: several_frame_release_rejections
cases.setup: Create bounded 4-frame real nested/recursive chain; make releases at deepest/third positions reject while other actual releases succeed.
cases.required: Actual rejected frames and same pins survive in order; unvisited prefix invariant holds; all four original frames attempted deepest first exactly once.

cases.name: all_frames_release_reject
cases.setup: Create three actual frames; corrupt original cache header pairing through held test-only original ticket replacement so all releases reject pre-effect.
cases.required: All three actual pins/frames and charges remain, terminal only; all attempts occur; no cache cleanup or header refund.

cases.name: guard_plus_multiple_rejected_frames
cases.setup: Create three actual caller frames then acquire fourth entry pin and fail nested completion/entry; reject guard plus at least two frame releases.
cases.required: One actual State guard pin and at least two frame pins survive simultaneously; no lone Option overwrite; all pinned/resident and live charges remain observable.

cases.name: release_failure_then_finish_drain
cases.setup: Make finish release fail after actual arena truncation; call drain.
cases.required: Rejected top frame begins in processed suffix, not attempted twice; stale base/operands/controls are never reused; lower frames still drain.

cases.name: failed_result_push
cases.setup: Use actual result-returning callee; fail caller result push work/operand/capacity/predebit boundary separately.
cases.required: Callee already retired and pin released; result does not publish; original push failure remains first while remaining callers drain.

cases.name: cleanup_live_undercount_reads_zero
cases.setup: Corrupt actual live Values/Controls/Frames accounting immediately before their actual cleanup removal.
cases.required: Cleanup continues; live_unreconciled latches even when ledger reads zero; no completion/header refund or generic cleanup bypass.

cases.name: prior_wasi_effect_and_first_failure
cases.setup: Perform a real permitted accounted WASI effect through existing direct host test boundary before entering real frames, then force trap/cancel/work failure and cleanup faults.
cases.required: Real WASI counters/bytes/denials are preserved in at_failure and after_cleanup; first cause/code/cursor remains unchanged; no fabricated WasiUsage default.

cases.name: dropped_phase_and_cleanup_resume
cases.setup: Drop Active phase at completed method boundary; reacquire cleanup-only using State record; also resume Retained and RestorePending with real original slots.
cases.required: No fresh admission/ordinary check/work; exact saved bound reused; each retained pin attempted once in new pass; no enter/finish/value access; terminal retained frames never interpreted.

cases.name: final_bound_restore_and_return_storage
cases.setup: Consume fixed actual preparation/entry/finish/drain Option slots; force outer restore rejection before refund and exercise cleanup-only retry.
cases.required: Every named large wrapper ends before shrink; exact previous bound restored only after all pin/live/nested obligations resolved; failure retains State bound and charge.

cases.name: provenance_and_consuming_barrier
cases.setup: Cross-pair original WASI/cache/state tickets while preserving all replaced authority in test fixtures; attempt prepare, resume, value operation and cleanup_owned.
cases.required: Reject before owner take/admission; retain original ticket/pin/arena owners; no direct cache teardown while frames/guard/bound/live latch present.

cases.name: warm_allocator_refusal
cases.setup: Warm actual functions before frame operation; install existing allocation observer rejecting first request during selected entry/return/drain/completion paths.
cases.required: Zero allocation requests in those intervals; cold cache decode allocations reported separately with ordinal source boundaries.

cases.name: frozen_and_existing_value_regressions
cases.setup: Run actual existing frozen and Swift owner/construction/cache/value tests, and public traces, minimal/all Debug/Release against exact baseline/candidate.
cases.required: Original frozen work/fuel/failure/allocation/observations/reservation unchanged; previously accepted zero-frame preparation remains strict; no new public route.

notAccepted: fabricated pin fixtures counted as frame execution
declaration compilation counted as active runtime acceptance
local checkout counted as published FieldLog qualification
